ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service systems can replace ticket checking and directions, but attendants still handle on-site emergencies and calm guests.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 392,300 Amusement And Recreation Attendants employed in 2024, rising to a projected 405,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 13,200 jobs and about 102,400 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $30,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace attendants who handle emergencies, but it will absorb much ticket checking and wayfinding. As self-service gates, navigation, and monitoring arrive, people shift from giving directions toward protecting safety and handling incidents. Pure guidance work will decline, while alert attendants with rescue skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site emergencies: people provide judgment.
Safety monitoring: people notice details.
Guest complaint de-escalation: people provide empathy.
Incident coordination: people provide teamwork.
Applying rules: people provide discretion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this career in a low-moderate AI exposure on-site environment. Automation absorbs guidance, but human safety service remains essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean universal risk. Automation replaces ticket checking and directions, not on-site emergency response. Alert attendants who can rescue and calm people become scarcer as technology advances. The vulnerable role is someone who only stands at a gate.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study tourism or service and earn credentials such as lifeguard certification.
Advance from guest guidance into area safety and build emergency experience.
Emphasize communication and emergency response and describe the settings you have handled.
Select people for patience and alertness; retain those who handle peak crowds.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service ticketing is becoming widespread.
Monitoring patrols are entering service.
Safety service faces greater shortages.

body: Amusement And Recreation Attendants do more than stand and collect tickets.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-service systems can replace ticket checking and directions, but attendants still handle on-site emergencies and calm guests.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 验票与指路能被自助替，但现场应急与安抚，还是服务长扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年娱乐与休闲服务员在岗约 39.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 40.55 万人，净增约 1.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代会应急的服务长，但会吃掉大量验票与指路。自助闸机、导航与监控上线，人从「指路」转向「管安全、处突发」。真正被挤掉的是纯引导，眼尖会救的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场应急：判断靠人。
安全盯防：眼尖靠人。
客诉安抚：共情靠人。
突发协调：默契靠人。
规则拿捏：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的现场区——引导被吃，但安全服务仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「验票指路」，不是「现场应急」的岗位。眼尖、会救、会安抚的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会站闸口的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读旅游/服务类，考救生等证书。
从引导升级成片区安全，攒应急经验。
突出沟通与应急，写清跟过哪些场景。
选人看耐心与眼尖，能扛高峰的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自助验票普及。
监控巡场上岗。
安全服务更缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can replace dispatch and registration tasks, but animal control workers still handle capture and conflict in the field.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,200 animal control workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 12,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with roughly 1,300 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $45,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace animal control workers, but it will support dispatch and registration. Systems assign calls and file records automatically, shifting people from forms to hands-on response. Pure clerical work faces pressure, while workers who can capture animals and communicate well become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field capture: people provide the necessary touch.
Conflict management: people provide the judgment.
Animal assessment: people provide the experience.
Owner communication: people provide the empathy.
Safety tradeoffs: people provide the restraint.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in the moderate AI-exposure range for field work. Clerical tasks are shrinking, but hands-on response still requires people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean universal risk. Systems can replace registration and dispatch, not on-site animal capture. Careful, courageous communicators become scarcer and more valuable as technology improves. Workers who only complete forms face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study animal science or public safety, and earn dog-handling and enforcement credentials.
Advance from support duties to independent response by building field experience.
Emphasize capture and communication skills, with clear examples of the situations you have handled.
Hire for courage, care, and composure. People capable of safe close-range response are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Smart dispatch is becoming widespread.
Electronic registration is becoming standard.
Hands-on responders are in shorter supply.

body: Animal control work protects people and animals by responding to calls, capturing and placing lost, dangerous, or abandoned animals, investigating violations and attacks, coordinating registration, quarantine, and transfer, and promoting responsible pet ownership. It supports both community safety and animal welfare.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can replace dispatch and registration tasks, but animal control workers still handle capture and conflict in the field.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 调度与登记能被系统替，但现场抓捕与冲突处理，还是管制扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年动物工人在岗约 1.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.27 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.58 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代动物管制员，但会辅助调度与登记。系统派单、自动归档，人从「填表」转向「近身处置」。真正被挤掉的是纯文书，会抓会沟通的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场抓捕：手感靠人。
冲突处理：脑子靠人。
动物判断：经验靠人。
主人沟通：共情靠人。
安全权衡：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的现场区——文书被吃，但近身处置仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「登记派单」，不是「现场抓捕」的岗位。胆大心细、会沟通的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会填表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读动科/治安类，考训犬与执法证。
从辅助升级成独立处置，攒现场经验。
突出抓捕与沟通，写清跟过哪些场景。
选人看胆大心细，能近身的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 智能派单普及。
电子登记上岗。
近身处置更缺。

body: 动物工人是在人与动物之间兜底的职业：接警响应出动，捕捉与安置走失、伤人或弃养动物，调查违规与伤人、登记检疫移交、宣传文明养宠，既维护社区公共安全也兼顾动物福。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 调度与登记能被系统替，但现场抓捕与冲突处理，还是管制扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assess damage and generate estimates, but skilled hands still straighten doors and apply paint evenly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 172,600 Automotive Body and Glass Repairers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 175,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,800 jobs, with roughly 14,600 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $51,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace automotive body repairers, but it will reshape early workflow stages. AI photo-based damage assessment, intelligent estimates, and automated color formulas make evaluation and pricing faster and more standardized. The main work begins afterward. Sheet-metal force, filler smoothness, paint color matching, and glass-installation precision all depend on craftsmanship. AI calculates what needs work, while repairers determine how to fix it.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent paint-mixing systems for faster color matching
Remote damage assessment that reduces waiting
Cloud sharing of repair data for new vehicle models
ai_s2_auto: AI photo-based damage assessment and automated estimates
Automated generation of paint color formulas
Digital repair orders and parts ordering
ai_s3_list: Sheet-metal craftsmanship: force and feel for frame alignment and dent repair.
Paint control: color mixing, spray-gun movement, color differences, and run correction.
Damage judgment: hidden structural damage can exceed visible damage.
New-material knowledge: repair processes for aluminum bodies, integrated castings, and composites.
Safety and responsibility: structural repairs affect road safety and cannot be rushed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means AI is taking over front-end assessment, estimating, and color matching, while hands-on body and paint work has limited direct exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure is not a reason for complacency. Repairers who rely only on traditional body and paint methods and ignore new materials face pressure. AI makes damage assessment more transparent and estimates more standardized, exposing differences in workmanship. Technicians who repair well, deliver quickly, and minimize rework become easier for the market to value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study automotive repair or body restoration. Body and paint work is a scarce and valuable specialization. Build strong skills in sheet metal, paint mixing, and welding, and follow electric-vehicle repair methods. Graduates are in demand at 4S dealerships and body-and-paint centers.

Learn aluminum-body and integrated-casting repair, and earn electric-vehicle repair credentials. Use AI damage assessment and intelligent paint-mixing tools. Moving from traditional repair toward faster, more accurate work strengthens pricing power.

People with mechanical, welding, or painting backgrounds can transition quickly. Bring before-and-after examples of repaired collision vehicles to interviews and specify the models and damage handled independently.

Distinguish general workers from skilled technicians when hiring body and paint staff. Pay premiums for new-process skills and electric-vehicle credentials, and provide clean paint booths and protective equipment. Retaining skilled technicians improves customer reputation.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Look up repair parameters for new vehicle models
Measure paint-film thickness and surface flatness

ai_s7_trends: AI damage assessment and intelligent paint mixing standardize evaluation, making hands-on craftsmanship scarcer.
Electric vehicles and integrated-cast bodies drive repair-process upgrades and increase demand for multi-skilled technicians.
Consolidated body-and-paint centers and stricter environmental and occupational-health standards raise industry barriers.

body: Automotive Body and Glass Repairers restore collision-damaged vehicles. They assess damage, shape sheet metal, apply filler and paint, repair finishes, and remove or replace vehicle glass, returning bodies to structural safety and acceptable appearance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assess damage and generate estimates, but skilled hands still straighten doors and apply paint evenly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 定损报价交给 AI，但把车门敲平、把漆喷匀，还是得靠这双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年汽车车身与玻璃维修工在岗约 17.26 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.54 万人，净增约 0.28 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代汽车车身维修工，但会重塑前段流程：AI 拍照定损、智能报价、颜色配方自动生成，正在让「评估与报价」更快更标准化。但评估完之后才是重头戏——钣金敲击的力度、腻子打磨的平整、喷漆的色差控制、玻璃的安装精度，全是手上的功夫。AI 管「算什么」，维修工管「怎么修」，两者不冲突。
ai_s2_accel: 3D 扫描辅助精准测量变形量
智能调漆系统提升配色效率
远程定损减少等待流程
新车型维修数据云端共享
ai_s2_auto: AI 拍照定损与自动报价
漆面颜色配方的自动生成
维修工单与配件下单线上化
损伤数据自动录入与归档
ai_s3_list: 钣金手艺：大梁校正、凹陷修复的力度与手感。
漆面控制：调色、喷枪走位、色差与流挂的处理。
损伤判断：内伤比外伤多，评估要看到结构层。
新材料认知：铝车身、一体压铸、复合材料的修复工艺。
安全与责任：结构修复关乎行车安全，不能糊弄。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明评估、报价、配色等前端环节正被 AI 大幅接管，但钣喷车间的手艺占比高，AI 实际接触面有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧：被挤压的是只会传统钣喷、不学新材料的师傅。AI 让定损更透明、报价更标准，手艺好坏更藏不住——修得好、交车快、返工少的技师，价值反而被市场看得更清楚。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读汽修或车身修复专业，钣喷是汽修里稀缺且手艺吃香的细分。在校把钣金、调漆、焊接练扎实，同时关注新能源汽车维修方向，毕业进 4S 店或钣喷中心都很抢手。
学铝车身与一体压铸修复工艺，考新能源汽车维修相关证书。把 AI 定损、智能调漆工具用起来，从「闷头修车」升级成「又快又准」的技师，议价力更强。
有机械、焊接、喷漆基础的人转型快。求职时带上修好的事故车前后对比案例，强调独立处理过什么车型和损伤，比空谈「会修车」有用得多。
别只按人头招钣喷工，要区分普通工与技师。给学新工艺、考新能源证书的师傅开溢价，配套无尘烤漆房与防护装备，技师留得住，客户口碑才上得来。

ai_s7_trends: AI 定损与智能调漆普及，评估环节标准化，手艺环节更稀缺。
新能源与一体压铸车身推动维修工艺升级，复合技师需求增长。
钣喷中心集约化，环保与职业健康要求抬高行业门槛。

body: 汽车车身及相关维修工负责对事故或损伤车辆进行车身修复：损伤评估、钣金整形、腻子喷涂、漆面修复、车窗玻璃拆装与更换，使车身恢复结构安全与外观状态。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can analyze test data and generate reports, but technicians still touch, listen to, and diagnose the prototype that sounds wrong on the test bench.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 38,300 engineering technicians employed in 2024. Employment is projected to remain at 38,300 by 2034, a net change of about 0 jobs, with roughly 3,200 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $68,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace automotive engineering technicians, but it will take over data tasks. Automated test-data collection, report generation, and preliminary anomaly screening shift technicians toward building benches, running tests, and verifying AI judgments. Physical test execution and on-site fault isolation still require people. Someone must place the prototype on the bench.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted anomaly isolation and root-cause analysis
Combined simulation and bench testing that reduces physical vehicle tests
Automated labeling of autonomous-driving road-test data
Digital twins that predict component life and reduce test items
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection and recording of test data
Automated preliminary screening and tagging of anomalous data
Digital test scheduling and sample management
ai_s3_list: Hands-on test operation: build benches and install or remove prototype components.
Fault isolation: use sound and data to locate the source of a problem.
Test-procedure judgment: decide what to test, when to stop, and whether data is reliable.
Engineer collaboration: translate on-site conditions into engineering language.
Safety and standards: respect strict limits in high-voltage and moving-equipment tests.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means AI is accelerating data and documentation work, while people still execute tests and isolate faults on site. Technicians shift from recording data to managing tests and validating results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still changes the role. Technicians who use AI data analysis and understand electric powertrain and autonomous-driving tests are in greater demand than traditional powertrain testers on new projects. Automation removes recording-only roles, while problem-solving technicians become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study vehicle engineering or mechanical engineering and gain hands-on experience in university laboratories or racing teams. Electrification and autonomous driving are leading directions. Graduates who understand electric powertrain systems and software testing command higher starting pay.

Move from traditional testing into electric powertrain, autonomous-driving, and software testing. Learn CAN communications, data-analysis tools, and AI reporting tools. Progression toward test engineer or calibration engineer is a strong path.

People with mechanical, electronics, or testing backgrounds can transition quickly into automotive testing. Resumes should specify benches built, tests run, and problems isolated, not only software names.

Electric-vehicle and autonomous-driving test talent is difficult to hire. Retain technicians through project participation + technical training + advancement paths. Technicians who analyze data with AI and run electric powertrain tests independently justify premium pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Anomaly detection and automated report generation
ECU parameter reading, writing, and calibration

ai_s7_trends: Demand for electric powertrain and autonomous-driving tests is growing, while traditional powertrain test roles shrink.
AI data analysis and digital twins reduce physical vehicle tests, shifting technicians toward test design and result validation.
In the software-defined vehicle era, technicians with CAN communications and software-testing skills are in strong demand.

body: Automotive Engineering Technicians assist engineers with design validation and testing of complete vehicles and components. They build benches, execute tests, collect and analyze data, tune prototypes, and isolate problems, linking design with engineering validation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can analyze test data and generate reports, but technicians still touch, listen to, and diagnose the prototype that sounds wrong on the test bench.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动分析试验数据、生成报告，但试验台架上那台「响得不对劲」的样车，还得靠技术员亲手去摸、去听、去定位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术员工程在岗约 3.83 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.83 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代汽车工程技术员，但会接管数据活儿：试验数据自动采集、报告生成、异常初筛都能交给 AI，技术员的注意力转向「搭台架、跑试验、验证 AI 判断」。试验的物理执行和现场问题定位，仍然需要人——AI 再聪明，也得有人把样车推到台架上去。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助试验异常定位与根因分析
仿真与台架试验结合减少实车测试次数
智能驾驶路测数据自动标注
数字孪生预测零部件寿命减少试验项
ai_s2_auto: 试验数据自动采集与记录
异常数据的自动初筛与标记
测试排程与样件管理数字化
ai_s3_list: 试验现场操作：台架搭建、样车拆装的动手能力。
异常定位：听声音、看数据判断问题源头。
测试规程判断：什么该测、什么该停、数据可不可信。
与工程师协同：把现场情况翻译成工程语言。
安全与规范：高压电、动设备试验的红线意识。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的「数据与文书」环节正被 AI 深度提速，但「试验执行与现场定位」仍然靠人；评分反映的是工作方式的改变——技术员从「记数据的人」变成「管试验、验结果的人」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：会 AI 数据分析、懂三电和智能驾驶试验的技术员，在新项目里比传统动力试验人才更抢手。纯「记录型」技术员会被自动化挤掉，会「定位问题」的反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选车辆工程或机械类专业，大学期间多进实验室和车队练手。电动化和智能驾驶是方向，会三电和软件测试的毕业生起薪明显更高。
从传统试验转三电、智能驾驶和软件测试方向，把 CAN 通信、数据分析工具和 AI 报告工具学熟。技术员往测试工程师、标定工程师走是正路。
有机械、电子或测试背景的转汽车试验岗上手快。简历上突出你搭过什么台架、跑过什么试验、定位过什么问题，别只写软件名。
新能源与智驾试验人才难招，用「项目参与度 + 技术培训 + 晋升通道」留人；会 AI 数据分析、能独立跑三电试验的技术员值得溢价。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 异常检测与报告自动生成

ai_s7_trends: 三电与智能驾驶试验需求增长，传统动力试验岗位收缩。
AI 数据分析与数字孪生减少实车试验次数，技术员转向试验设计与结果验证。
软件定义汽车时代，懂 CAN 通信与软件测试的技术员成为香饽饽。

body: 汽车工程技术员协助汽车工程师开展整车与零部件的设计验证与试验测试，负责台架搭建、试验执行、数据采集分析、样车调试与问题定位，是汽车研发链条中承上启下的工程支。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动分析试验数据、生成报告，但试验台架上那台「响得不对劲」的样车，还得靠技术员亲手去摸、去听、去定位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated coffee machines can produce a standard cup, but baristas still explain flavor, create latte art, and build guest relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,796,000 baristas were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 4,029,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 233,200 jobs, with approximately 904,300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $30,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace baristas, but it will reduce standardized roles. Automated coffee machines and convenience-store service accelerate basic Americanos and lattes, shifting baristas from standard drinks toward specialty pour-overs, signature beverage development, guest relationships, and experience. People limited to basic drinks face the most pressure, while baristas with flavor knowledge and hospitality skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Flavor explanation: human taste remains essential.
Latte art: human wrist control remains essential.
Signature beverage development: human creativity remains essential.
Client relationships: people maintain trust.
On-site workflow: people manage the moment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, places this career in a low AI-exposure bar environment. Extraction and hospitality depend heavily on tactile skill and experience, which systems cannot yet replicate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Standard drink preparation faces replacement, while specialty coffee and guest experience roles do not. Baristas with flavor knowledge and hospitality skills become scarcer, while people limited to basic drinks face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with training and practice extraction and latte art. Standard drink work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop flavor knowledge and guest relationships early.
Advance from making drinks to developing signature beverages and cultivating regulars, with a path toward lead barista or an independent shop.
Emphasize consistency and the range of drinks you can make. Shops value stable output and quality control.
When hiring, look beyond speed to flavor judgment and hospitality. Core baristas with these skills merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated coffee machines expand and standardized roles shrink.
Specialty coffee and signature beverages create opportunities.
Baristas with strong guest-relationship skills are more sought after.

body: Baristas grind, extract, and prepare coffee drinks from recipes. They operate espresso machines and pour-over equipment, control milk texture and latte art, serve customers, and keep the bar and supplies clean.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated coffee machines can produce a standard cup, but baristas still explain flavor, create latte art, and build guest relationships.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动咖啡机能出标准杯，但风味讲解、拉花和客情，还是咖啡师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年咖啡师在岗约 379.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 402.92 万人，净增约 23.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 90.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代咖啡师，但会压缩标准岗。自动咖啡机和便利店出品把美式、拿铁基础款提速，咖啡师从「出标准杯」挪向「精品手冲、特调研发、客情与体验」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础款的人，有风味和待客力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 风味讲解：舌头靠人。
拉花手感：手腕靠人。
特调研发：创意靠人。
客情经营：关系靠人。
现场节奏：临场靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的吧台区——萃取与待客高度依赖手感和经验，系统暂时接不住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「标准杯」动作，不是「精品与体验」的岗位。有风味、能待客的人，反而更稀缺。怕的是只会出基础款。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从培训起步多练萃取和拉花，AI 时代纯标准杯在缩，早点练风味和客情。
从「出杯」升级成「做特调 + 养客」，往 lead 或开店走。
突出稳定性和出品种类，门店看重稳和品控。
选人别只看速度，看风味判断和待客，骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动咖啡机普及，标准岗缩。
精品与特调带来机会。
有客情力的咖啡师更抢手。

body: 咖啡师按配方研磨、萃取与调配咖啡饮品，操作意式机与手冲设备，把控奶泡与拉花，服务客人并维护吧台卫生与物料。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动咖啡机能出标准杯，但风味讲解、拉花和客情，还是咖啡师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Business dashboards can calculate every metric, but the CEO still decides whether the company should bet on a market.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 309,400 Chief Executives were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 322,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,300 jobs, with about 22,200 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $206,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chief Executives, but it will accelerate decision preparation. AI speeds up business analysis, industry research, and document drafting, shifting CEOs from finding information toward making judgments, leading teams, and owning results. Leaders who only relay messages face marginalization; executives with strategic courage become scarcer.
ai_s2_accel: Quantitative workforce and organizational health diagnostics
Intelligent preparation for customer and investor communication
ai_s2_auto: Automated business dashboards and financial analysis
Automated industry research and competitor intelligence summaries
Assisted drafting of board materials and speeches
Automated public sentiment and risk monitoring alerts
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: people choose the markets.
Critical decisions: people approve major investments.
Team leadership: people shape culture and morale.
Crisis leadership: people set the tone amid disorder.
External representation: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range for decision preparation. Systems accelerate analysis and documents, but people retain responsibility for judgment and outcomes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk: information organization is being replaced, not accountable decision-making. CEOs with foresight, resolve, and ownership become scarcer as information grows more transparent. Leaders who only relay messages and avoid decisions face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is a long path. Develop deep expertise in one function before moving into management. An MBA and cross-functional experience are useful, but proven leadership through major projects matters most.
Move from executing well to setting direction and allocating resources. Develop strategic communication and decision-making courage, then pursue responsibility for a larger business scope.
Executive roles depend more on results and networks than applications. Highlight the outcomes you owned and the teams you led.

Do not select leaders on polished resumes alone. Look for people who have owned difficult outcomes and made decisions at turning points. Executives who decide boldly and remain steady are the scarcest.

ai_s7_trends: Automated business analysis shifts CEOs toward judgment and team leadership.
Demand rises for leaders experienced in digitalization and transformation.
Tenure volatility grows, with stronger performance commitments and accountability.

body: Chief Executives are the highest-ranking operating leaders of organizations. They set and execute strategy, annual goals, and major investments; coordinate functions; answer to the board; represent the organization in critical external decisions; and hold final responsibility for business results.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Business dashboards can calculate every metric, but the CEO still decides whether the company should bet on a market.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 经营看板能把数据算得明明白白，但「该不该赌这条赛道」，最后还是 CEO 拍。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年首席执行官在岗约 30.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.27 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 20.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 CEO，但会加速决策准备。经营分析、行业研究、文档起草被 AI 提速，CEO 从「找信息」挪向「做判断、带队伍、扛结果」。真正被边缘的是只会传达、不会决断的管理者，有战略魄力的一号位更稀缺。
ai_s2_accel: 情景模拟辅助战略推演
人才与组织健康的量化诊断
客户与资本沟通的智能准备
决策备忘录的结构化生成
ai_s2_auto: 经营看板与财务分析的自动生成
行业研究与竞品情报的自动汇总
董事会材料与演讲稿的起草辅助
舆情与风险的自动监测预警
ai_s3_list: 战略判断：赛道取舍靠人定。
关键决策：重大投资要人拍。
带队打仗：文化士气靠人带。
危机定调：乱局中人要镇场。
对外代表：信任关系靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的决策准备区——分析与文档被系统加速，但判断与担责还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「信息整理」动作，不是「拍板担责」的岗位。有远见、敢决断、能扛结果的 CEO，反而随信息透明更稀缺。怕的是只会传话、不敢拍板的管理者。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这条路长，先在某职能做深再走管理。MBA 和跨职能历练有用，但真本事是扛过几个大项目。
从「把事做好」升级成「定方向分资源」，练战略表达和决策胆识，争取管更大盘子。
高管岗不靠投简历，靠业绩和圈子。突出你扛过的结果和带过的队伍。
选人别只看履历光鲜，要看真扛过事、能在拐点决断。敢拍板又稳得住的一号位最稀缺。

ai_s7_trends: 经营分析自动化，CEO 更聚焦判断与带队。
数字化与转型型一把手需求上升。
任期波动加大，对赌与问责更重。

body: 首席执行官是企业最高经营负责人，制定并推动公司战略、年度目标与重大投资，统筹各职能条线，向董事会负责并代表企业对外关键决策，对企业经营结果承担最终责任。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 经营看板能把数据算得明明白白，但「该不该赌这条赛道」，最后还是 CEO 拍。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule production, record data, and calculate parameters, but operators still install dies in presses and adjust the first piece until it passes inspection.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 174,700 Cutting, Punching, And Press Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic employed in 2024, projected to decline to 153,600 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 21,100 jobs, with about 14,400 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $45,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace press machine operators, but it will change the role structure. AI takes over production scheduling, process-parameter records, and quality-data entry, while automated lines and robotic handling replace some repetitive operations. Workers shift from pressing buttons toward CNC operation, setup, and exception handling. On-site judgment during die setup, accountability for first-piece approval, and real-time equipment response remain human responsibilities. Machines calculate, but people verify die alignment and part quality.
ai_s2_accel: CNC presses and automated production lines spread
Robotic loading and unloading replace repetitive handling
Vision inspection automatically identifies surface defects
ai_s2_auto: Automated production scheduling and job dispatch
ai_s3_list: On-site die setup judgment: tactile skill determines the right clearance, stroke, and pressure.
First-piece approval and quality accountability: the first part determines the batch, and a person signs off.
Real-time equipment response: experience guides shutdown decisions for abnormal sounds, jams, and dimensional drift.
Executing safety discipline: press equipment is hazardous, and people must follow every operating step.
Process-problem feedback: people explain unreasonable parameters and die wear to technicians.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means automated systems now handle much of the workflow and recordkeeping, including scheduling, data, and monitoring. This occupation has low-moderate AI exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Automated lines require operators with stronger setup and CNC skills, making troubleshooting ability scarcer. Pure manual handling and button-pushing roles face pressure, while hybrid operators who understand CNC systems and dies command a clear premium.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study mechanical engineering, CNC machining, or die and mold technology, and build foundations in CNC programming and CAD. Manufacturing combines craft + technology; CNC and die-related technical roles offer more stable pay and development.
Learn CNC programming, automated-line maintenance, and die setup. Move from operation toward setup + process work. People who can set up equipment remain more valuable than those who only operate it.

Career changers with mechanical or automotive-repair backgrounds can ramp up quickly. Start as an operator, earn occupational skill-level credentials while working, and progress toward setup and die work.
Do not hire operators on physical strength alone. Evaluate willingness to learn and safety awareness. Younger workers who learn CNC systems and setup can become the core of workshop upgrades.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated loading, unloading, and linked-line operation
Scheduling, production reporting, and data records

ai_s7_trends: CNC systems and automated production lines become mainstream. Pure manual roles shrink as operators combine CNC + setup + process skills.
Vision inspection and AI process optimization spread, making quality decisions more data-based, while first-piece approval and exception handling still require people.
Automotive, appliance, and new-energy manufacturing drive press-work demand. Skill-level credentials gain value, and certified setup technicians become more sought after.

body: Metal press and shear equipment operators install dies, set parameters, and run presses, shears, and punching machines to form metal sheet and plastic parts from drawings and process cards.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule production, record data, and calculate parameters, but operators still install dies in presses and adjust the first piece until it passes inspection.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你排产、录数据、算参数，但把模具装进冲床、把首件调合格的那双手，还得是操作工的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 17.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.36 万人，岗位净减约 2.11 万个，年均产生约 1.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.56 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代冲压机床操作工，但会改变岗位结构。排产调度、工艺参数记录、质检数据录入都被 AI 接手，自动化产线和机器人上下料替代了部分重复操作，操作工从「按按钮」转向「会数控、懂调试、能处置」。真正不可替代的是装模调试的现场判断、首件确认的质量责任，以及设备异常的临场处置——机器能算，但模装得正不正、件合不合格，靠人确认。
ai_s2_accel: 数控冲床与自动化产线普及
机器人上下料替代重复搬运
视觉检测自动判断外观缺陷
冲压工艺 AI 优化参数
ai_s2_auto: 生产排程与派工自动化
工艺参数记录与数据录入
设备运行状态自动监控
ai_s3_list: 装模调试的现场判断：模具间隙、行程、压力，调得对不对靠手感。
首件确认与质量责任：批量好不好，第一件说了算，签字担责的是人。
设备异常的临场处置：异响、卡料、尺寸飘，停机判断靠经验。
安全意识的执行：冲压设备危险，每一步操作按规程，机器不懂怕。
工艺问题反馈：参数不合理、模具磨损，怎么跟技术员讲清楚靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的流程与记录工作正被自动化——排产、数据、监控都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为自动化产线普及，操作工被要求「更会调机、更懂数控」，调试和处置能力反而更稀缺。真正被挤压的是纯手动上下料和按按钮操作，会数控、懂模具的复合型操作工溢价明显。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读机械、数控或模具专业，把数控编程和 CAD 基础学好。制造业是「手艺+技术」的行业，数控与模具方向的技能岗收入和发展更稳。
主动学数控编程、自动化产线维护和模具调试，从「操作」升级为「调试+工艺」。会调机的人永远比只会操作的人值钱。
有机械、汽修背景的转行者上手快。从操作工切入，边干边考职业技能等级证书，向调试和模具方向发展。
招操作工别只看体力，要看学习意愿和安全意识。愿意学数控与调试的年轻人，是车间转型升级的骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 数控与自动化产线成为主流，纯手动操作岗位收缩，操作工向「数控+调试+工艺」复合转型。
视觉检测与 AI 工艺优化普及，质量判定逐步数据化，但首件确认与异常处置仍靠人。
汽车、家电与新能源制造带动冲压需求，技能等级证书含金量提升，持证调试工更抢手。

body: 金属冲压与剪压设备操作工是冲压机床操作工（金属与塑料）负责冲压、剪板、冲孔等压力加工机床的模具安装、参数调试与批量操作，依据图纸和工艺卡完成金属板材与塑料件。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你排产、录数据、算参数，但把模具装进冲床、把首件调合格的那双手，还得是操作工的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Intraoral scanning and intelligent scheduling can replace records, but Dental assistants still manage four-handed dentistry and infection control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 381,900 Dental assistants were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 406,300 by 2034. That represents about 24,400 additional jobs, with roughly 52,900 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $47,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dental assistants, but it will reduce clerical work. Intraoral scanning and intelligent scheduling accelerate records and appointments. Assistants shift toward chairside support, infection control, patient reassurance, and workflow coordination. Registration-only work faces the greatest pressure, while assistants skilled in four-handed dentistry and sterilization become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Four-handed dentistry: people coordinate chairside care.
Suction control: people maintain a clear field.
Infection control: people perform sterilization.
Patient reassurance: people respond to emotions.
Chair turnover: people maintain the workflow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Dental assistants in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate records and scheduling, while people still perform chairside work and infection control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Systems replace registration and scheduling, not the combined work of four-handed dentistry, sterilization, and patient reassurance. Assistants with strong infection-control habits and chairside coordination become scarcer as clinics improve efficiency.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with dental assistant training and practice four-handed dentistry and sterilization. Registration-only work is shrinking, so develop chairside coordination early.
Advance from passing instruments to four-handed dentistry + infection control. Learn to assist with intraoral scanning.
Highlight clinic experience and certifications. Specify the procedures and specialties you supported.
Do not assess candidates on diligence alone. Evaluate infection-control awareness and chairside coordination.

ai_s7_trends: Intraoral scanning expands, reducing record work.
Infection-control requirements become stricter.
Assistants skilled in four-handed dentistry become more sought after.

body: Dental assistants support dentists during oral treatment through four-handed dentistry. They manage instruments, suction, impressions, patient reassurance, and infection-control sterilization.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Intraoral scanning and intelligent scheduling can replace records, but Dental assistants still manage four-handed dentistry and infection control.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 口扫与智能预约能替记录，但椅旁四手和感染控制还是助理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年牙科助理在岗约 38.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 40.63 万人，净增约 2.44 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代牙科助理，但会压缩文书。口内扫描与智能预约把记录和排程提速，助理从「写病历」挪向「椅旁配合、感染控制、患者安抚、流程协调」。真正被挤掉的是只做登记排程的，会四手能灭菌的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 四手操作：配合靠人。
控吸唾：视野靠人。
感染控制：灭菌靠人。
患者安抚：情绪靠人。
椅位流转：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——记录排程被系统加速，但椅旁与感染控制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「登记排程」，不是「四手 + 灭菌 + 安抚」的复合岗。有无菌意识和配合力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 卫校/培训起步多练四手和灭菌，纯登记在缩，早点练配合。
从「递器械」升级成「四手+感染控制」，学口扫配合。
突出诊所经验和证书，写清跟过哪些项目。
选人别只看勤快，要看无菌意识和配合手感。

ai_s7_trends: 口扫普及，记录缩。
感染控制更严。
会四手的人更抢手。

body: 牙科助理在口腔诊疗中配合牙医完成四手操作，负责器械、吸唾、印模、安抚与院感消毒。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 口扫与智能预约能替记录，但椅旁四手和感染控制还是助理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can build schedules and send notices, but only a person can notice why someone stopped attending and offer genuine pastoral care.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 138,900 Directors, Religious Activities And Education were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 141,800 by 2034. That represents about 2,900 additional jobs and roughly 13,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $54,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Directors, Religious Activities And Education. The occupation centers on accompaniment, pastoral care, and interpersonal trust. AI can assist with scheduling, notices, course materials, and statistics. That administrative support leaves more time for listening and helping community members grow.
ai_s2_accel: Wider use of online worship and livestreaming tools
ai_s2_auto: Automated activity scheduling and reminder notices
Organization of course materials and presentations
Management of member information and participation records
ai_s3_list: Pastoral care: offer support and direction during important moments.
Interpersonal trust: create conditions in which community members can speak openly.
Community mobilization: bring volunteers together as a team.
Religious education: explain faith in a way people can understand and internalize.
Conflict coordination: use judgment and restraint on sensitive issues.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places Directors, Religious Activities And Education in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Face-to-face interaction and trust limit automation, while AI can streamline administrative work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still requires adaptation. Automating notices, schedules, and course-material organization returns time to people and ministry. Digital tools can create more capacity for direct care rather than threaten the occupation's human core.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Theology is not the only route into this field. Social work, education, and nonprofit management also provide strong foundations. This mission-driven career has income and advancement patterns that depend heavily on the institution.

Use digital scheduling, notification, and course platforms to reduce administrative work and preserve time for pastoral care. Address generational issues and teach in formats younger participants understand.
People with social-work, teaching, or nonprofit-operations backgrounds often transition well. In interviews, show organization and empathy through activities led and communities served.
The hardest candidates to find combine a genuine commitment to service with operational skill. Define responsibilities clearly and provide training so volunteer management has accountable ownership.

ai_s7_trends: Religious institutions accelerate digital adoption, making online activities and courses standard options.
Changing participation across generations drives innovation in education and activity formats.
Charitable and community-service projects take a larger share of institutional work.

body: Directors, Religious Activities And Education coordinate worship and education within religious organizations. They plan activities, manage religious courses, oversee clergy and volunteers, and operate charitable and community-service programs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can build schedules and send notices, but only a person can notice why someone stopped attending and offer genuine pastoral care.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能排课表、能群发通知，但「这个人为什么不再来聚会了」——这种陪伴和牧养，只有活生生的人能做到。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年总监、教育在岗约 13.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.18 万人，净增约 0.29 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.38 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代宗教活动与教育总监：这个岗位的核心是人与人之间的陪伴、牧养和信任，是 AI 最不擅长的事。AI 能帮的只是外围行政——活动排期、通知触达、课程资料整理、数据统计，这些可以让总监腾出手来多做真正重要的事：听人说话、陪人成长。
ai_s2_accel: 线上敬拜与直播工具普及
AI 辅助课程内容创作
社区服务需求数据化分析
志愿者排班与沟通自动化
ai_s2_auto: 活动排期与提醒通知自动化
会众信息与参与记录管理
活动宣传素材的批量生成
ai_s3_list: 牧养陪伴：在关键时刻给人支持和方向。
人际信任：让会众愿意向你敞开。
组织动员：把志愿者凝聚成团队。
课程教导：把信仰讲得入心入脑。
冲突协调：敏感议题下的分寸与智慧。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这是「中高曝光」的服务型岗位：工作高度依赖面对面的人际互动和信任关系，AI 能优化的只有行政面；评估模型对你的判断，核心是「跟人有关的工作，自动化程度天然有限」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于原地不动：用 AI 把通知、排期、资料整理这些杂事解决掉，你就能把时间还给人和事工——数字化工具不是威胁，是你腾出陪伴时间的杠杆。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走这条路不一定要神学专业，社会工作、教育、非营利管理都是好基础；但要想清楚这是「呼召型」职业，收入和发展取决于机构，家里要有平常心。
把数字化工具用起来（排期、通知、课程平台），把杂事自动化，把时间留给牧养；同时关注代际议题，用年轻人听得进去的方式做教育。
有社工、教师、非营利运营背景的人转过来最顺；面试时突出组织能力和同理心，讲清楚你带过什么活动、陪伴过什么样的人。
这类岗位难招的是「真心愿意服侍又懂运营」的人；给清晰的职责边界和培训支持，别把志愿者管理变成无人认领的烂摊子。

ai_s7_trends: 宗教机构数字化提速，线上活动与课程成为标配。
代际参与度变化，倒逼教育与活动形式创新。
社会服务属性增强，慈善与社区项目比重上升。

body: 宗教活动与教育总监统筹宗教团体内的敬拜与教育活动，负责活动策划、宗教教育课程、教职人员与志愿者管理，以及慈善与社区服务项目的运营。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI customer service can take orders and vending machines never rest, but reading a person's reaction and closing the sale still depends on you.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 25,300 Door To Door Sales Workers, News And Street Vendors, And Related Workers were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 22,800 by 2034. That represents about 2,500 fewer jobs and roughly 2,700 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $34,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Door To Door Sales Workers, News And Street Vendors, And Related Workers as a whole, but it will change how they sell. Mobile tools increasingly handle bookkeeping, change, inventory, and route planning. AI customer service and vending machines divert standardized transactions, while face-to-face persuasion, bargaining, and repeat-customer relationships remain human. Sellers who choose products well, understand people, and move part of the business online gain more room to grow.
ai_s2_accel: AI customer service that handles routine inquiries and redirects phone orders
Vending machines and unattended shelves that replace standardized sales
Community group buying and livestream commerce that compete for customer traffic
Customer-management tools that automate repeat-business outreach
ai_s2_auto: Digital bookkeeping, change calculation, and QR-code payments
Mobile-app management of purchasing and inventory
ai_s3_list: Live selling: capture attention in one sentence and adapt the pitch to the person.
Personal trust: repeat customers return for the seller, not the app.
Product judgment: experience reveals which goods sell in each location.
Resilience: after ten rejections, start the eleventh conversation with the same energy.
Integrity and compliance: shortchanging customers destroys a reputation, and reputation sustains the business.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Digital tools increasingly handle bookkeeping, payments, inventory, and change, automating about half of the operating workflow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over transactions, while people still create sales through face-to-face persuasion, bargaining, and repeat-customer relationships. High-volume undifferentiated selling faces the greatest pressure. Sellers who select products well, understand people, and operate online are more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is not a strong lifelong career plan, but holiday vending and field promotion build communication skills and resilience. Students can strengthen marketing fundamentals and learn digital bookkeeping tools.

Use digital payments, inventory, and customer-management tools. Learn livestream selling, short-form video, and product selection. Replace pure volume selling with an integrated product, customer-community, and livestream strategy, and obtain the required business licenses.

This is one of the lowest-barrier bridge jobs and a practical way to build sales confidence. For a longer career, move into product sourcing, field-sales management, or livestream operations instead of relying only on walking and talking.

When hiring field-sales or vendor teams, evaluate repeat business and reputation as well as daily sales. Sellers who use tools, manage customer communities, and build a territory over time create more value than one-off volume campaigns.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Price comparison, purchasing, and product-selection guidance
Foot-traffic heat maps for location selection
Selling through livestreams and short-form video

ai_s7_trends: Digital transactions move sellers from cash and change toward QR-code payments and customer communities, making hybrid online distribution more stable.
Community group buying, night markets, and street vending create new settings where product selection and compliant operations provide an advantage.
Pure volume selling is narrowing, while livestreams, short-form video, and private customer communities give vendors and direct sellers a second storefront.

body: Door To Door Sales Workers, News And Street Vendors, And Related Workers sell newspapers, food, and household goods across streets, residential areas, and businesses. They source goods, make pitches, sell on site, collect and reconcile payments, and maintain repeat customers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 客服能接单、自动售卖机不休息，但「看人脸色把东西卖出去」的那口气，还得是你自己喘。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人销售在岗约 2.53 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.28 万人，岗位净减约 0.25 万个，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.45 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会整体取代上门推销员和摊贩，但会改变售卖方式。记账、找零、库存、路线规划正被手机工具接管，AI 客服和自动售卖机分流标准化售卖；而面对面推销、砍价、熟客经营，是机器替代不了的。会选品、懂人情、能转线上经营的从业者反而更有空间。
ai_s2_accel: AI 客服承接标准咨询，分流电话订单
自动售卖机与无人货架替代标准化售卖
社区团购与直播带货抢占客流
私域工具自动维护熟客与复购
ai_s2_auto: 记账找零与扫码收款电子化
进货库存用手机 App 管理
路线与摊位选址靠地图工具
ai_s3_list: 临场推销：一句话抓住人心，看人下菜碟。
人情与信任：熟客认你这个人，不认 App。
选品眼光：什么货在什么地段好卖，靠经验。
应变与厚脸皮：被拒绝十次，第十一次还能开口。
诚信与合规：缺斤短两砸招牌，口碑是命根子。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半的运营环节正被数字化——记账、收款、库存、找零，App 和工具都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「交易」环节，留下的是「成交」环节——面对面推销、砍价、熟客经营反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯跑量、无差异的售卖，会选品、懂人情、能转线上的从业者更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不把它当终身职业规划，但假期摆摊、地推是练口才和抗挫的好机会。读书期间把沟通和营销基础打好，学会用工具记账。
把收款、库存、私域工具用起来，学直播带货和短视频选品。从「跑量推销」升级为「选品+私域+直播」三合一，有条件就注册执照合规经营。
这是门槛最低的过渡性工作，适合练销售胆量。想长期做，就往选品采购、地推管理或直播运营方向走，别只靠腿和嘴。
如果雇地推或摊贩团队，别只看单日业绩，要看复购和口碑。会用工具、懂私域、能长期守一片区域的从业者，比一次性跑量更值钱。

ai_s7_trends: 交易数字化普及，从业者从「现金找零」转向「扫码+私域」，会经营线上客户的分销更稳。
社区团购、夜市与地摊经济提供新场景，选品与合规经营成为竞争力。
纯跑量推销空间收窄，直播、短视频与私域成为摊贩与推销员的第二摊位。

body: 上门推销员、报贩与街头摊贩负责在街头、居民区与商户间流动售卖报刊、食品与日用杂货，包括选品进货、上门推销、现场叫卖、收款对账与熟客维护。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 客服能接单、自动售卖机不休息，但「看人脸色把东西卖出去」的那口气，还得是你自己喘。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring systems can read meters automatically, but Energy Engineers still decide what to upgrade, how to calculate returns, and who will coordinate implementation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 158,800 Energy Engineers, Except Wind And Solar were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 162,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 3,300 jobs, with about 9,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $117,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Energy Engineers, Except Wind And Solar, but it will reduce manual meter reading. Energy monitoring and simulation speed up audits, shifting engineers from recording readings toward solution design, return analysis, retrofit coordination, and carbon strategy. Roles limited to data transcription face the most pressure. Engineers who design systems and understand the economics become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Solution design: people choose the retrofit.
Return analysis: people evaluate the investment.
Retrofit coordination: people drive implementation.
System tradeoffs: people make the choices.
Carbon strategy: people set the accounting boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in energy-efficiency engineering. Systems accelerate meter reading and modeling, but design and coordination remain human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. Systems replace manual meter-reading tasks, not solution-design roles. Engineers who design systems and calculate returns become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to recording readings face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering and practice system analysis and cost calculations. Manual meter reading is shrinking in the AI era, so develop design skills early.
Advance from meter reading to solution design and return analysis. Learn simulation and carbon accounting, then seek project responsibility.
Highlight energy-efficiency projects and industry experience. Specify the systems you have worked on. Employers value reliable, accurate delivery.
Do not assess candidates by attention to detail alone. Test whether they can design systems. Core staff who calculate returns merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Monitoring expands while manual meter reading contracts.
Dual-carbon goals create retrofit opportunities.
Engineers who design systems and calculate returns become more sought after.

body: Energy Engineers, Except Wind And Solar assess energy use in buildings and industrial systems. They design efficiency and waste-heat recovery solutions and coordinate audits.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Monitoring systems can read meters automatically, but Energy Engineers still decide what to upgrade, how to calculate returns, and who will coordinate implementation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测能自动抄表，但哪块该改、怎么算回报、谁去协调，还是能源定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年能源工程师（风电与太阳能除外）在岗约 15.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.21 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.93 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.78 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代能源工程师，但会压缩手工抄表。能耗监测与仿真把审计提速，能源从「抄表」挪向「方案设计、回报核算、改造协调、碳策略」。真正被挤掉的是只做抄录的，会设计能算账的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 方案设计：改造靠人定。
回报核算：投资靠人算。
改造协调：落地靠人推。
系统权衡：取舍靠人。
碳策略：口径靠人把。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的能效区——抄表和建模被系统加速，但设计与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「手工抄表」动作，不是「方案设计」的岗位。会设计、能算账的能源，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会抄表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电/化工起步多练系统和算账，AI 时代纯抄表在缩，早点练设计。
从「抄表」升级成「做方案 + 算回报」，学仿真与碳账，争取项目。
突出节能项目和行业经验，写清跟过哪些系统。企业看重稳和准。
选人别只看细心，要看有没有设计脑子。能算回报的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 监测普及，抄表缩。
双碳拉动改造机会。
会设计能算账更抢手。

body: Energy Engineers, Except Wind And Solar（中文名查表缺失）评估建筑与工业能耗，设计节能与余热回收方案，统筹审计。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Drones can survey a forest and AI can estimate harvest volume, but when a large tree starts to crack, Fallers still rely on experience to choose an escape direction and adjust the cut.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 5,600 Fallers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 5,200 by 2034, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with about 700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $53,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fallers, but it will change harvest-site management. Drone surveys, AI harvest planning, and digital timber measurement are becoming common. Fallers are moving from judging an entire forest by sight to working from detailed plans. Machines cannot replace the feel of a saw, judgment of fall direction, or rapid safety decisions on site. Experienced Fallers who operate equipment and follow strict safety practices can gain stability during the shift to mechanized harvesting.
ai_s3_list: Fall-direction judgment: tree tension, wind, and slope require an on-site feel that AI cannot reproduce.
Cutting technique: notch and back-cut depth and angle depend on practiced hands.
On-site safety response: people must react to falling deadwood and sudden trunk splits.
Work on difficult terrain: people handle steep slopes and dense forests that machines cannot reach.
Equipment feel: experienced workers can hear whether a chainsaw is operating correctly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 indicates relatively low AI exposure. AI is improving surveys, plans, and measurement, but people still make the cuts and safety decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean the work is unchanged. Mechanized harvesting is replacing some manual work, and traditional logging volume is constrained. People are still needed for thinning and difficult terrain. Licensed, experienced Fallers who understand machinery should remain more stable during the transition.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Forestry vocational programs provide an entry route, but the industry is contracting. Study forestry technology or ecological management and work toward technical or management roles instead of focusing only on tree felling.

Learn to operate harvesting machinery and use drone-based plans, then earn advanced work credentials. Moving toward harvester operation or harvest-site management reduces dependence on manual chainsaw work.
Mechanical or outdoor experience helps, but safety training comes first. On a resume, name the equipment you operated, the timber volume you harvested, and the safety procedures you know.
Put safety training first in hiring. Logging depends on experience and discipline. Drone surveys and mechanized harvesting can reduce risk substantially when crews use them correctly.

ai_s7_trends: Mechanized harvesting and drone planning are expanding. Manual chainsaw work is shrinking as Fallers combine equipment operation with on-site judgment.
Natural-forest protection and harvest quotas are becoming standard, shifting work toward ecological management and thinning.
Stricter safety oversight is raising credential and cross-skill requirements. Experienced Fallers who understand machinery are becoming more valuable.

body: Fallers use chainsaws and other tools to bring down trees safely according to a harvest plan. They judge fall direction, control cuts, remove limbs, buck stems to specification, coordinate skidding and loading, and follow safety and environmental rules.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Drones can survey a forest and AI can estimate harvest volume, but when a large tree starts to crack, Fallers still rely on experience to choose an escape direction and adjust the cut.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人机能提前看清林子、AI 能算采伐量，但大树「咯吱」一响的那几秒，往哪边躲、锯口怎么补，还得靠伐木工的经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年伐木工在岗约 0.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.52 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.39 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代伐木工，但会改变伐区管理。无人机勘察、AI 采伐规划、木材计量正普及，伐木工从「靠眼睛看林子」转向「按规划作业」；但锯木的手感、倒向的判断和现场安全应变，机器替代不了。会用设备、懂安全的老伐木工，在机械采伐转型里反而更稳。
ai_s3_list: 倒向判断：树的张力、风向、坡向，AI 算不出现场手感。
锯口工艺：下口背口的深度角度，靠手上功夫。
现场安全应变：枯枝坠落、树突然开裂，反应靠人。
复杂地形的作业：陡坡、密林，机械化到不了的地方靠人。
设备的保养手感：油锯状态好不好，听声就知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的规划与计量环节正被 AI 优化——勘察、规划、计量都自动化了，但锯树和安全判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化。机械采伐在替代人工，传统伐木量受限；但复杂地形和间伐作业仍需人，懂机械、持证、经验丰富的伐木工在转型期更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 林业技校是入门通道，但行业在收缩，建议学林业技术、生态经营方向，向管理和技术岗走，别只盯着伐木。
把采伐机械和无人机规划用起来，考更高级别的作业资格。往机械采伐手、伐区管理方向转，避开纯人工油锯岗。
有机械或户外经验最好，先过安全培训。简历上多写「操作过什么设备、伐过多少方、熟悉什么安全规程」。
招人把安全培训放第一位，伐木靠经验更靠纪律。给作业组配无人机勘察和机械采伐，能显著降低风险。

ai_s7_trends: 机械采伐与无人机规划普及，纯人工油锯伐木收缩，伐木工转向「设备操作+现场判断」。
天然林保护与限额采伐成为常态，采伐向生态经营与抚育间伐转型。
安全监管趋严，持证与技能复合要求上升，懂机械的老伐木工更吃香。

body: 伐木工（Fallers）使用油锯等工具按计划安全放倒树木，负责判断倒向、控制锯口、清理枝桠、按规格造材，并配合集材与装运作业，同时执行采伐安全与生态保护规范。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate lectures, simulated cases, and test questions, but teachers must still correct a student's misplaced injection and guide clinical reasoning at the bedside.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 289,600 postsecondary health specialties teachers in 2024, projected to rise to 339,700 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 50,100 jobs, with roughly 27,400 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $105,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary health specialties teachers, but it will change teaching. AI greatly accelerates slides, lectures, question banks, and simulated cases, while virtual simulation makes practice more efficient. Clinical instruction, laboratory demonstrations, patient communication, mentorship, and professional formation remain human. Teachers will move from lecturers toward instructional designers and clinical educators.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of slides and lectures
Automated question banks and exam assembly
Management of grades and course-evaluation data
Integration of lesson plans and course resources
ai_s3_list: Clinical instruction: hands-on bedside teaching.
Procedural demonstration: model standardized techniques.
Professional formation: values and professional conduct.
Course design: organize knowledge into a coherent system.
Research supervision: guide student projects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places postsecondary health teaching in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Content generation, question banks, and virtual simulation are changing instruction, but clinical teaching, procedural demonstrations, and mentorship still require teachers. The role is shifting toward design and clinical instruction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure calls for a new position. Do not remain only a knowledge lecturer, because AI delivers information faster. Focus on clinical instruction, course design, and mentorship. Let AI help prepare lessons and spend your time at the bedside and with students.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A doctorate is generally the entry ticket for postsecondary health teaching, and a clinical background adds value. Build strong clinical foundations as an undergraduate and participate in teaching practice during graduate and doctoral study rather than focusing only on experiments.

Adopt AI teaching tools to reduce time spent preparing lessons and question banks. Develop clinical instruction and teaching reform, pursue education-improvement projects, and advance clinical, teaching, and research work together for promotion.

Physicians and nurses have an advantage when moving into teaching. Develop instructional fundamentals such as communication and course design, begin through affiliated-hospital instruction or adjunct teaching, and present clinical cases and teaching experience in interviews.

Balance research metrics with teaching ability in faculty hiring. AI can expand instructional capacity, so reserve positions for educators strong in clinical instruction and mentorship. Reduce burdens on early-career faculty so rigid promotion systems do not drive away excellent teachers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid generation of lectures and slides

ai_s7_trends: Expansion in nursing, rehabilitation, and public health increases demand for health specialties teachers.
AI slides and virtual simulation are spreading, rapidly changing instructional formats.
Clinically experienced, dual-qualified teachers are a priority in institutional hiring.

body: Postsecondary health specialties teachers teach medicine, nursing, pharmacy, rehabilitation, and other health programs, provide laboratory guidance and clinical instruction, conduct teaching reform and research, and prepare healthcare professionals.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成讲义、模拟病例、自动出题，但「学生这一针扎偏了、这个病例怎么引导思考」的床边教学，还得靠老师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校健康专业教师在岗约 28.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 33.97 万人，净增约 5.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.74 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.56 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校健康专业教师，但会改变教学：课件、讲义、题库、模拟病例这些内容生成正被 AI 大幅加速，虚拟仿真让练习更高效；而临床带教、实验示范、医患沟通的言传身教和育人陪伴，AI 替代不了。教师会从「讲台上的讲授者」变成「教学设计与临床带教者」。
ai_s2_accel: 虚拟仿真手术与操作训练
ai_s3_list: 临床带教：床边手把手的教学。
操作示范：把规范动作做标准。
育人引导：价值观与职业素养。
课程设计：把知识组织成体系。
科研指导：带学生做课题。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明高校健康教师是「中高曝光」的教育岗位：内容生成、题库、虚拟仿真正在改变教学形式，但临床带教、操作示范和育人陪伴仍需教师本人，岗位向设计与带教转型。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒你换个定位：别再只当「讲知识的」，AI 知识讲得比你快。把重心放到临床带教、课程设计和育人上，AI 帮你备课，你把时间花在床边和学生身上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当高校健康专业教师，博士学历基本是入场券，临床背景更吃香；本科阶段把临床功底打扎实，读研读博期间多参与教学实践，别只闷头做实验。
拥抱 AI 教学工具，把备课和题库时间压缩下来；往临床带教和教学改革方向做，申报教改课题，职称评审时「临床 + 教学 + 科研」三线并进。
临床医生或护士转教学有优势：先把教学基本功补上（表达、课程设计），从附属医院带教或兼职教师做起；面试时展示临床案例和带教经验。
院校招聘要平衡「科研指标」和「教学能力」：AI 能补教学产能，把编制留给临床带教强、能育人的老师；同时给青年教师减负，别让非升即走逼走好老师。

ai_s7_trends: 护理、康复、公卫等专业扩招，健康专业教师需求增长。
AI 课件与虚拟仿真普及，教学形式加速变革。
临床型、双师型教师成为院校招聘重点。

body: 高校健康专业教师在高等学校承担医学、护理、药学、康复等健康专业课程的教学、实验指导与临床带教，开展教学改革与科研工作，培养医疗健康领域专业人才。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate machining programs automatically, but a machinist at the machine still decides how a batch of material will deform and whether a tool needs replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 299,500 machinists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 299,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 29,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $56,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace machinists, but it will change machining methods. CAM automated programming, in-process measurement, and process databases are entering workshops, making routine machine operation increasingly automated. Yet machinists still rely on experience to judge material deformation, tool wear, and abnormal conditions. AI replaces button-pushing operators, not technicians who understand manufacturing processes.
ai_s2_accel: AI-based tool-life prediction and replacement alerts
Vision inspection for first-piece and in-process checks
Digital-twin simulation to reduce trial cuts
ai_s2_auto: Automated CAM programming and toolpath generation
In-process measurement and automatic dimensional compensation
Digital process sheets and production records
CNC program transfer and simulation validation
ai_s3_list: Process judgment: experience guides decisions about combinations of materials, tools, and equipment.
Troubleshooting: diagnose broken tools, chatter, and dimensional drift on site.
Workholding and tool setting: precise control of deformation and datum establishment.
Quality awareness: understand how tolerances affect assembly.
Equipment maintenance: machine condition determines machining quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means automation is taking over much of the programming, measurement, and recordkeeping. A machinist's core value is shifting toward process planning, troubleshooting, and complex-part setup, increasing the value of advanced skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Do not panic about medium-to-high exposure. Automation replaces machine operators who only push buttons and lack process knowledge, while manufacturers compete for technicians who can program, understand materials, and troubleshoot. Mastering CAM and in-process measurement provides a route from an operating role into a technical one.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A vocational-school machining program offers strong value through low costs and practical demand. Students should master CNC programming and machining centers before graduation, then start as apprentices and become independent within two or three years. Do not overvalue academic credentials; craftsmanship matters in this field.

Master automated CAM programming, in-process measurement, and machining simulation, while adding knowledge of cutting tools and materials. Moving from machine operation toward programming plus process engineering is the most effective defense against automation.

If you have a mechanical background and want to move into workshop work, first learn CNC programming and basic machine operation, then start as an apprentice or machine operator. On your résumé, clearly identify the equipment you operate, materials you understand, and process problems you have solved; this is more convincing than certificates alone.

Do not hire solely from certificates; a trial cut on site quickly reveals skill level. Retaining one master machinist is more valuable than hiring ten beginners. Giving highly skilled technicians responsibility for process improvement and apprenticeships is the best investment against automation.

ai_s7_trends: As automated CAM programming and in-process measurement spread, machinists shift from machine operation toward process design.
Smart manufacturing keeps multidisciplinary technicians who understand programming and processes and can troubleshoot in short supply.
Retirements among master machinists and limited entry by young workers increase the bargaining power of highly skilled machinists.

body: Machinists use metal-cutting equipment such as lathes, milling machines, and machining centers to turn metal blanks into precision parts according to drawings. They handle programming, workholding, tool setup, machining, measurement, and process adjustments, making them crucial to turning manufacturing drawings into physical products.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动生成加工程序，但「这批料的变形趋势、这把刀该不该换」，还得机械师在机床边拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械加工在岗约 29.95 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 29.96 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.95 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机械师，但会改变加工方式：CAM 自动编程、在线测量、工艺数据库都在进场，普通操机环节越来越自动化。但材料变形、刀具磨损、异常排故这些现场判断，依然靠机械师的经验。AI 取代的是「会按键的操机工」，不是「懂工艺的技师」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 刀具寿命预测与换刀提醒
加工参数优化推荐系统
视觉检测辅助首件与在线检验
数字孪生仿真减少试切次数
ai_s2_auto: CAM 自动编程与刀路生成
在线测量与尺寸自动补偿
工艺卡与生产记录电子化
数控程序传输与仿真校验
ai_s3_list: 工艺判断：材料、刀具、设备的组合决策靠经验。
异常处理：崩刀、震刀、尺寸飘移的现场排故。
装夹与校刀：变形控制、基准建立的细腻功夫。
质量意识：看懂公差背后对装配的影响。
设备维护：机床状态好坏决定加工质量。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明编程、测量、记录这些环节正被自动化大幅接管，机械师的核心价值转向工艺方案、异常处理和复杂零件的调试，技能含金量反而在上升。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不必慌：被替代的是「只会按键、不懂工艺」的操机工，而「会编程、懂材料、能排故」的技师是制造业抢着要的。主动把 CAM、在线测量这些工具用熟，就是从「操作岗」走向「技术岗」的跳板。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校机械加工专业是性价比很高的选择：投入低、需求实。建议孩子在校就练熟数控编程和加工中心，毕业后从学徒做起，两三年就能独当一面。别迷信学历，这行看手艺。
把 CAM 自动编程、在线测量、加工仿真用熟，补点刀具和材料知识。从「操机」走向「编程 + 工艺」，是抵抗自动化冲击最有效的路径。
有机械基础想转行进车间，先学数控编程和基本操机，从学徒或操机工起步。简历里写清你会哪些设备、懂什么材料、处理过什么工艺难题，比证书更有说服力。
招人别只看证书，现场试一刀就知道水平；留住老师傅比招十个新手划算。给高技能技师配工艺改进和带徒机制，是抵御自动化冲击的最好投入。

ai_s7_trends: CAM 自动编程与在线测量普及，机械师从「操机」转向「工艺设计」。
智能制造推进，懂编程、懂工艺、能排故的复合技师持续稀缺。
老师傅退休潮叠加年轻人入行少，高技能机械师议价能力上升。

body: 机械师使用车床、铣床、加工中心等金属切削设备，把金属毛坯按图纸加工成精密零件，负责编程、装夹、调刀、加工、测量与工艺调整，是制造业从图纸到实物的关键执行者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: SaaS can automate schedules, but planners still decide which events to accept, how to turn them into long-term partnerships, and how to handle emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 155,800 Meeting, Convention, And Event Planners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 163,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 7,500 jobs, with around 15,500 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $59,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Meeting, Convention, And Event Planners, but it will reduce standard roles. Templates and SaaS accelerate routine coordination, shifting planners from schedules toward client development, custom plans, on-site response, and long-term relationships. Standard-only coordinators face pressure, while strong organizers gain value.
ai_s3_list: Client management: people sustain relationships.
Plan customization: people uncover needs.
On-site response: people handle emergencies.
Vendor negotiation: people negotiate terms.
Long-term relationships: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this career in the relatively high AI exposure tier for coordination. Systems accelerate standard event work, while coordination and customization remain human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard scheduling, not event coordination. Planners who organize resources and customize plans become scarcer, while standard-only coordinators face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in execution and practice projects and communication. Pure scheduling is contracting, so learn coordination early.
Advance from schedules to custom plans and client development. Learn budgets and on-site work and pursue major events.
Highlight event scale and clients, clearly identifying event types. Clients value reliability and drive.
When hiring, look beyond attention to detail and assess coordination ability. Core planners who handle major events deserve strong commissions.

ai_s7_trends: SaaS spreads, reducing standard roles.
Large custom events create opportunities.
Planners with strong coordination skills are in greater demand.

body: Meeting, Convention, And Event Planners coordinate event concepts, budgets, vendors, and on-site execution, using project and communication skills to achieve goals and control delivery risk.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: SaaS 能自动排程，但哪类活动值得接、怎么讲成长期合作、现场突发怎么扛，还是策划定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年会议、会展与活动策划师在岗约 15.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.33 万人，净增约 0.75 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.94 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代会议会展策划，但会压缩标准岗。模板与 SaaS 把常规会务提速，策划从「排流程」挪向「客户经营、方案定制、现场应变、长期关系」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准会务的，有统筹力能定制的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 客户经营：关系靠人养。
方案定制：需求靠人挖。
现场应变：突发靠人扛。
供应商谈判：条件靠人谈。
长期关系：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的统筹区——标准会务被系统加速，但统筹与定制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排标准流程」动作，不是「活动统筹」的岗位。有统筹力、能定制方案的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做标准会务的策划。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从执行练起，多练项目与沟通，AI 时代纯排程在缩，早点练统筹。
从「排流程」升级成「做方案 + 养客户」，学预算与现场，争取大活动。
突出跟过的活动量级和客户，写清操过哪些类型。甲方看重稳和冲。

ai_s2_accel: Intelligent guidance for peak call queues
ai_s2_auto: Voice navigation directs callers to departments
ai_s3_list: Complex inquiries: People interpret intent.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range for call routing. Systems handle standard calls, but people remain essential for inquiries and reception.

Advance from connecting extensions to reception and coordination. Learn visitor and emergency procedures and pursue a combined administrative role.
Highlight examples of responsiveness and courtesy and specify the systems you have used. Organizations value consistency and speed.

body: Switchboard operators, including answering service, use telephone switchboards and answering systems to route calls, record messages, register visitors, and connect departments. They serve as the organization's communications front desk and keep internal and external contacts running smoothly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Voice navigation can route calls to departments automatically, but an operator's ears and voice still determine how to calm an urgent caller and which visitors should be admitted.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 语音导航能自动把电话分到部门，但那通急事怎么安抚、访客谁接谁不接，还是接线员的耳和嘴定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年总机接线员（含应答服务）在岗约 3.66 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.70 万人，岗位净减约 0.96 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代总机接线员，但会加速转接。IVR 与自动总机把标准来电分流，接线员从「切分机」挪向「复杂查询、安抚、现场接待与应急联络」。真正被挤掉的是纯转接，反应快会接待的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 复杂查询：意图靠人判。
情绪安抚：急事靠人。
现场接待：分寸靠人。
应急联络：突发靠人。
部门协调：关系靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的转接区——标准来电被系统分流，但查询与接待还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯转接与登记」动作，不是「联络接待」的岗位。反应快、会安抚的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照目录切分机的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 行政/商务打底，在校多练沟通与系统。AI 时代纯转接在缩，早点练接待。
从「切分机」升级成「做接待 + 协调」，学访客与应急，争取兼行政。
突出反应与礼貌案例，写清跟过哪些系统。机构看重稳和快。
选人别只看声音甜，要看慌不慌。能接待会协调的，值得留。

ai_s7_trends: IVR 提效，标准转接缩。
复杂查询仍刚需。
会接待协调的更缺。

body: Telephone operators answer, triage, and transfer incoming calls, coordinating intent, numbers, and records. They use systems and communication scripts to route calls to the correct destination and retain documentation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Speech recognition can route calls through self-service systems, but operators still determine callers' intent, calm emergencies, and find the right person.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 语音识别能自助转，但意图怎么判、紧急怎么安抚、找谁最对，还是接线员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电话接线员在岗约 0.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.29 万人，岗位净减约 0.11 万个，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.91 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会大幅压缩电话接线员。IVR 与语音识别把标准查号与转接自动化，接线员从「接转」挪向「复杂分流、安抚、找对人」。真正被挤掉的是纯转接，懂判断、能安抚的人还能留。
ai_s3_list: 复杂分流：意图靠人判。
紧急安抚：情绪靠人稳。
找对人：关系靠人。
方言处理：理解靠人。
特殊求助：处置靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——标准转接被系统加速，但复杂分流还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光等于较高风险：被替代的是「接标准转」动作，不是「复杂分流与安抚」的岗位。有判断、能安抚的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会纯转接的接线员。

突出零误转与复杂处理，业主看重稳和准。
选人别只看快，看耐心和判断，骨干值得给总机岗。

ai_s7_trends: IVR 普及，标准岗缩。
复杂分流仍有机会。
能安抚的接线员更稳。

career_ai_description_block.heading: 语音识别能自助转，但意图怎么判、紧急怎么安抚、找谁最对，还是接线员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Layout software can calculate quantities, but craftspeople still align joints by feel and handle irregular shapes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 52,600 tile and marble setters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 58,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,400 jobs, with approximately 4,200 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $52,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tile and marble setters, but it will reduce standardized installation. Layout and quantity calculations become faster, shifting craftspeople from standard tiles toward irregular stone, premium finishing, and on-site problem-solving. Workers who only install square tiles face displacement, while skilled craftspeople become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Tactile joint alignment: People adjust the joints.
Irregular-shape handling: People cut the material.
Flatness correction: People measure and adjust the surface.
On-site adaptability: People fill defects.
Premium finishing: People create the final appearance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates moderately high AI exposure in a skilled trade. Quantity calculations accelerate, but tactile skill remains human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard tile installation, not irregular finishing roles. Skilled workers who resolve on-site issues become scarcer as efficiency improves. Workers who only install square tiles face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: As an apprentice, practice tactile control and irregular shapes. Standard work is shrinking in the AI era, so learn stonework early.
Advance from square tiles to irregular shapes + finishing, and learn layout tools.
Highlight projects and finished work, including the materials you have installed. Renovation employers value steadiness and detail.
Do not select workers solely for low prices. Evaluate craftsmanship judgment. Craftspeople who finish edges well deserve premium rates.

ai_s7_trends: Faster quantity calculations
Prefabrication takes standard roles
Craftspeople who handle irregular shapes are in greater demand

body: Tile and marble setters install wall and floor finishes, coordinating leveling, layout, setting, and edge finishing. They use materials and construction methods to create durable, attractive finish surfaces.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Layout software can calculate quantities, but craftspeople still align joints by feel and handle irregular shapes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排版软件能量算，但手感对缝和异形处置，还是师傅定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代铺贴工，但会压缩标准铺贴。排版与量算被加速，师傅从「铺标准砖」挪向「异形石材、高端收口、现场处置」。真正被挤掉的是只铺方砖的，有手艺人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 手感对缝：缝靠人调。
异形处置：料靠人裁。
平整校正：平靠人量。
现场应变：坑靠人补。
高端收口：美靠人做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的手艺区——量算被加速，但手感还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「铺标准砖」动作，不是「异形收口」的岗位。有手艺人、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会铺方砖的工。

突出项目和成品，写清跟过哪些材料。装修看重稳和细。
选人别只看价低，要看有没有手艺脑子。能收口的师傅值得给高价。
